mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5pp over 3 months, it signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp over 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) declines month-over-month for two consecutive months, it signals a potential recession that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines MoM for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: PAYEMS declines MoM for 2 consecutive months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a weakening housing market and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST declines > 10% YoY but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) grows by more than 5% year-over-year, it signals strong economic growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO grows > 5% YoY but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) both exceed their respective 12-month moving averages, it signals tightening financial conditions that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both exceed their 12-month MAs but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% year-over-year, it signals strong consumer demand that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS grows > 5% YoY but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.
